title: Factory move B: the deploy path and the embedded payload
description:
The half of the factory move that carries the build context, split out from v3i because the embedded payload is the expensive part rather than the Go code.

Move: deploy.go, rollout.go, migrate.go, wrangler.go, toolchain.go (docker), plus the embedded payload — cloud/factory, cloud/sandbox, and the module-root embedded.go additions. //go:embed cannot reach across modules, which is why the payload has to travel with the code; cloud/sandbox alone is 236K of build context.

Wire 'ticfac factory deploy' and 'ticfac factory setup'.

Touchpoints, all of them: ~/.tick/factory/bundle as a staging directory (deploy.go:142 in ticks), one 'git remote get-url origin' (setup.go:1406), docker (toolchain.go:59,124) and wrangler (wrangler.go:206). No herdr references. It never reads or writes a tracker record.

Use the source pin ek7 established for which ticks ref the sandbox's tk is built from.

Do NOT delete anything from the ticks repo here; that is tick v3i-d's job and a separate PR against a separate repo.
acceptance_criteria: ticfac factory deploy and setup work from the ticfac CLI with the embedded payload building correctly; the sandbox image builds from the pinned ticks ref established in ek7; no ticks Go package is imported; ticks is untouched by this tick; go test -short -timeout 45m ./... green (make test-short).
